ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AGI Infra Limited successfully completed a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP), raising Rs. 275 Crore by allotting 10.38 million equity shares at Rs. 265 each, increasing its paid-up capital and infusing substantial funds. This transaction, while providing a significant capital boost, results in dilution for existing shareholders and reveals a high concentration, with over 65% of the QIP shares allocated to just five institutional investors, including a single entity taking 27.38% of the total issue.
